name: sitecommenter
description: Screen annotations and UI feedback with screenshots (React module + Chrome extension)

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm -w @sitecommenter/demo run build && npm run showcase
scripts.demo: npm -w @sitecommenter/demo run build && npm -w @sitecommenter/demo run serve
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @sitecommenter/ui-comments run typecheck && npm -w @sitecommenter/extension run typecheck && npm -w @sitecommenter/demo run typecheck
